source:
@@U04646@@
(Strewing roses.)

@@U04647@@
Roses, you glowing ones, Balsam-bestowing ones, Fluttering, quivering, Sweetness delivering, Blossom half-opening, Branching unblightedly, Budding delightedly, Scatter around you Spring, Purple and green. Take him to Paradise, This sleeper serene!

@@U04649@@
(To the SATANS.)

@@U04650@@
What’s all this? This dodging and ducking? Is that what they taught you in Hell? Stand fast, let them strew till they're blue in the face! To your posts, you idiots! They're trying to snow-in flaming-hot devils with their fluttery flurry of flowers, but you have only to breathe and it melts and shrivels! Blow now, you blowhards! Puffers and snorters, blow! Stop! Enough! Enough! Your foul breath is blighting the whole swarm! Not so hard! Muzzle your mouths, harness your noses! You've overblown those roses. Show moderation! They've not just wilted, they've browned, they’ve dried, they're burning! Pelting us now, they are, with shining, poisonous flames!
translation:
@@U04646@@
（撒上玫瑰花。）

@@U04647@@
玫瑰，你们这些发光的，赐香的，飘飘颤抖，送来甘甜，花儿半开，枝条完好，含苞欲放，散落在你们身边，春天，紫绿。带他去天堂，这个沉睡的安详！

@@U04649@@
（对撒旦来说。）

@@U04650@@
这一切是什么？这躲闪？这就是他们在地狱里教你的吗？站稳了，让它们洒得满脸青紫！去你的帖子吧，你们这些白痴！他们试图用飞舞的花朵将炽热的魔鬼降入雪中，但你只要呼吸一下，它就会融化并枯萎！吹吧，你们这些吹牛的人！吹气者和鼻喷者，吹！停止！足够的！足够的！你的恶臭呼吸正在毁掉整个虫群！没那么难！堵住你的嘴，管住你的鼻子！你把那些玫瑰花吹得太过了。表现出节制！它们不仅枯萎了，还变成了褐色，变干了，还在燃烧！现在，它们正带着闪亮的毒焰向我们袭来！
